import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct)
    root = des.rootComponent
    im = app.importManager
    path='/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate_right_tb/gasket_v1/mx_plate_right_tb_gasket.dxf'
    opts = im.createDXF2DImportOptions(path, root.xYConstructionPlane)
    ok = im.importToTarget(opts, root)
    print(json.dumps({'success': bool(ok), 'sketches': [s.name for s in root.sketches], 'count': root.sketches.count}))
